import cadquery as cq
import math

# === 参数 ===
outer_w = 60   # 外宽 (mm)
outer_h = 80   # 外高 (mm)
thickness = 15 # 厚度 (mm)
jaw_w = 15     # 钳口宽 (mm)
gap = 30       # 开口高度 (mm)
fillet_r = 5   # 内圆角 (mm)

# === 建模 ===
outer = cq.Workplane("XY").box(outer_w, outer_h, thickness)
inner = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .box(outer_w - jaw_w, gap, thickness)
    .translate(((jaw_w) / 2, 0, 0))
)
result = outer.cut(inner)

# 圆角
result = result.edges("|Z").fillet(fillet_r)

show_object(result)
